highlights: OpenAI and Aleph Alpha introduce powerful new models, GPT-6.1 Sol and Kolibri, pushing the boundaries of intelligence and efficiency while Microsoft achieves a new benchmark in real-time speech-to-text.
The agentic AI landscape is rapidly evolving with OpenAI's 'dots' proactive assistants, DeepSeek's open-source agent harness desktop apps, and NVIDIA's DGX Spark for local agent development.

Enterprises gain critical new capabilities through Google's privacy-preserving federated learning in TEEs, IBM's self-hosted agentic software platform, and Prime Intellect's serverless inference for frontier models.

agents.title: Introducing dots: OpenAI's Proactive AI Assistants
agents.summary: OpenAI has launched 'dots', proactive AI assistants designed to autonomously manage complex projects and daily tasks, empowering users to maintain control while work progresses seamlessly.

agents.title: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness
agents.summary: DeepSeek has released official macOS and Windows desktop applications for its MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness v0.2, enhancing agent development with a plugin manager, file/code review, scheduled automation, and support for OpenAI-compatible models.

agents.title: Holo4: Powering Generalist Computer-Use Agents
agents.summary: Holo4 is introduced as a new model specifically designed to power generalist computer-use agents, marking a significant step towards more versatile and capable AI assistants that can interact with various digital environments.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol: Near-Astra Intelligence at Reduced Cost
models.summary: OpenAI unveils GPT-6.1 Sol, a new frontier model offering intelligence close to Astra for coding, computer use, and professional tasks, at one-fifth the standard API input and output token prices of Astra.

models.title: Aleph Alpha Releases Kolibri: A 78.1B Open-Weight English-German MoE Model With Only 3.46B Active Parameters
models.summary: Aleph Alpha has launched Kolibri, a 78.1B-parameter English-German Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that activates only 3.46B parameters per token, featuring a 1M-token context and Apache 2.0 FP8 weights runnable on a single B200 or H200 GPU.

models.title: Microsoft AI Releases MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming: #1 Real-Time Speech-to-Text Model
models.summary: Microsoft AI has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, its inaugural real-time speech-to-text model, which ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis AA-WER Streaming with a 2.5% WER, supports 60 languages with continuous detection, and is available in public preview.

tools.title: NVIDIA Announces DGX Spark 64GB: A 1-PetaFLOP Grace Blackwell Desktop for Local AI
tools.summary: NVIDIA has introduced a new 64GB configuration of its DGX Spark, a GB10-powered desktop AI system from multiple vendors, providing developers with 1 PetaFLOP for local AI agents, fine-tuning, and inference, with clustering capabilities for expanded memory.

tools.title: Prime Intellect Launches Prime Inference: Serverless and Reserved Serving for Frontier Open Models
tools.summary: Prime Intellect has introduced Prime Inference, an OpenAI-compatible platform offering serverless and reserved serving for frontier open models on NVIDIA Blackwell, utilizing technologies like Dynamo, vLLM, and NVFP4 KV compression for high-performance inference.

tools.title: Transformers Now Runs Llama.cpp Quants
tools.summary: The Hugging Face Transformers library now supports running llama.cpp quantized models, significantly enhancing efficiency and accessibility for developers working with Llama models and extending the utility of a widely used machine learning library.

companies.title: Google Research Moves Federated Learning Into TEEs: Gboard Now Trains With Externally Verifiable Differential Privacy
companies.summary: Google Research has developed a federated learning system that shifts gradient computation into attested server-side TEEs, enabling Gboard to train with externally verifiable differential privacy for features like next-word prediction, ensuring enhanced user data security.

companies.title: IBM Brings Bob to Self-Hosted and Air-Gapped Environments: Agentic Software Development Without Moving Your Code
companies.summary: IBM has made its agentic software development platform, IBM Bob, generally available for self-hosted and air-gapped environments, allowing enterprises to run it on-premises or in private clouds, integrating with various models while ensuring full data isolation.

companies.title: Disrupting a Coordinated Model-Distillation Campaign
companies.summary: OpenAI details how it successfully disrupted a campaign aimed at extracting protected model reasoning and outlines measures being taken to strengthen defenses against adversarial distillation, reinforcing the security and integrity of its AI models.

learning.title: A Model Guide for the GPT-6 Family
learning.summary: OpenAI provides a comprehensive guide for startups on effectively utilizing GPT-6 models, covering crucial topics such as model selection, reasoning effort tuning, prompt engineering, skill enhancement, tool coordination, and preparing workflows for production.

learning.title: DevFest is Back: Build, Secure, and Scale in the Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, offering developers opportunities to connect, learn, and collaborate on building, securing, and scaling applications within the rapidly evolving agentic AI era.

learning.title: Rebuilding AUTOMATIC1111 with Gradio Workflow
learning.summary: A guide demonstrating how to rebuild the popular AUTOMATIC1111 tool using Gradio Workflow, offering developers a new approach to enhance and customize their Stable Diffusion UI experience.
